From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Mar 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: mobility stipend & work-permit reimbursement for offer to Isabel Moreno

Hi Monica / Laura,

We're ready to extend an offer to Isabel Moreno for Sr. Machine Learning Engineer (start target: 2027-06-01). Isabel is currently in Madrid and will require a work-permit for the US. Recruitment has proposed the following package as part of the offer:

- Base: $160,000 (band aligned)
- Sign-on: $15,000 (one-time)
- Mobility subsidy / onboarding stipend (one-time): $12,000
- Work-permit & legal fees (estimated): $6,000 (to be invoiced to Redwood / reimbursed)

Total mobility-related request: $18,000 (mobility stipend + permit/legal fees).

Attachments: offer_letter_Isabel_Moreno_2027.pdf, mobility_budget_breakdown_Isabel.xlsx

Action items / asks:
1) Monica — can People Ops approve the $12k mobility subsidy + procedure to route the immigration invoice to AP?
2) Vivek — legal/finance: confirm whether the $6k estimate should be paid directly to the immigration vendor (GMP) or reimbursed to the candidate. Also confirm budget code and any tax treatment notes for the stipend.
3) Laura — hiring manager sign-off on the above (we can mark the offer conditional on approvals).

Timing is tight: candidate asked for the offer by next Tuesday (23 Mar). Please reply with approvals or blockers by Mon EOD so we can finalize comp and send the letter.

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Lead, Talent Acquisition (acting)
Redwood Inference

Thanks Karthik — quick clarifying questions before we sign off:

- Is the $12k mobility subsidy intended to cover: temporary housing (1–2 months), one-way travel, and a small settling-in allowance? Please break it out if you have a preferred allocation.
- For the $6k legal estimate, is that a fixed cap or a working estimate? If it's an estimate we'll want the immigration vendor to provide an itemized quote and payment terms.

People Ops policy notes: we typically cap standard mobility stipends at $10k for remote hires and $15k for senior hires requiring international relocation. There is precedent for a $12k one-time payment if the hiring manager agrees to the business justification (hard-to-fill role + strategic team need).

If you can supply the mobility budget breakdown with line items I will:
- Route the $12k approval to Finance (AP code: HR-MOB-2027)
- Confirm taxation treatment (one-time stipend usually taxable in the US payroll jurisdiction; we need candidate country details for cross-border tax implications)
- Request GMP (Global Mobility Partners) to send a formal estimate and payment instructions.

Please see attached: mobility_policy_variant.pdf (internal).

Subject: Re: Request: mobility stipend & work-permit reimbursement for offer to Isabel Moreno

Karthik / Monica — I approve the proposed mobility stipend of $12,000 and the estimated legal fees up to $6,000 (total up to $18k) for this hire. Business justification: role is critical for Q3 roadmap (multimodal ranking work) and Isabel's profile is hard to replace in the near term.

Conditions / requests:
- Please mark the offer "contingent on obtaining work-permit" and include a 90-day start flexibility clause in case the permit timeline slips.
- Monica — we'd like GMP to provide an expedited service option and estimate (try to get timeline + premium fee if any). If expedited fee pushes legal estimate above $6k, escalate to me before approving.
- Karthik — please confirm relocation vs. remote onboarding plan (will she be expected in SF office Day 1 or allowed hybrid for the first 3 months). That impacts the housing/travel allocation.

- Work-permit (O-1 / H-1B route planning and filing support): $4,250 (standard service)
- Premium processing / expedited option: +$2,500 (optional)
- Local counsel fees (state-specific filings, translations, courier): $650
- Relocation coordination & temporary housing coordination (2 months): $2,300

Estimated total (standard): $7,200
Estimated total (with premium expedited processing): $9,700

We can issue an itemized quote and a formal invoice. Standard payment terms: net 30 to Redwood; for expedited premium we require a 50% deposit at engagement. Attached: GMP_estimate_Isabel_2027.pdf

Next steps we recommend:
1) Confirm whether Redwood will cover GMP fees directly or reimburse Isabel.
2) If direct payment, provide PO / billing contact and AP code (HR-MOB-2027).
3) If expedited processing is desired, confirm within 24 hours so we can reserve premium slots.
